sections.overview: This little-known snailfish is the sole described species of the genus Prognatholiparis.
sections.identification: Its lower jaw projects beyond the upper jaw, and conspicuous folds of skin mark the snout and underside of the jaw.
sections.habitat: It is known from the Aleutian Islands in the northeast Pacific; records place it on the seabed at moderate depth.
sections.diet: The only reported stomach observation found ostracods and stones, too little evidence to define its usual diet.
sections.behavior: The consulted account gives no species-specific behavioral details.
sections.reproduction: The consulted account gives no species-specific reproductive details.
sections.ecology: It is a marine, bottom-associated fish, and the known record base is exceptionally sparse.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports Data Deficient in the IUCN assessment it cites, dated 2009.
